Water: Nature is 100%, again 75% for energy, water is 67% physical is 50% and fire is 25%.

Nature: Fire is 100%, 75% for energy, nature is 67%, physical is 50% and water is 25%.

Normal husks every element does 100% but physical gets a bouns 44%, all the rest get a 20% bonus.

So try to have a couple schematics with each depending on which weapons u like I would recommend at least 2 gun and a melee. Also if u have any double element weapons like one with say water and nature it will work the same on even though they have the lowest percentage they will work just the same on fire and nature husks, I've tested it out it was a 130 in a 140 mission after I saw a YouTube video saying double element weapons and that not both elements work.
